groups.saying_opens: قرأ ابن عباس ألا إنهم يثنون صدورهم

notes: Three sayings, each labelled: Ibn Abbas's reading (1); «وقال غيره عن ابن عباس», an unnamed transmitter at the level of عمرو (2), read as Sufyan's other route; «وقال مجاهد» with no transmitter, a single-link group (3, rule 10).
Glosses inside the sayings (وضاق بهم، بقطع من الليل) are kept as text; the saying 3 opener is only two words in the text.
